'''Darth Venamis''' was a prospective [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|lineage]] of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], he was the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of the Dark Lord, [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]]. Tenebrous trained Venamis in violation of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], since he had another apprentice, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. Despite Venamis's use of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] title, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]], it was not legitimately bestowed upon him.

==Biography==
[[File:DarthTenebrous-SWI130.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Darth Tenebrous, Venamis' Sith Master]]
Venamis claimed to have been found by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]], and selected as an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] unbeknownst to the other [[Rule of Two/Legends|Banite]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] trained under Tenebrous' tutelage, the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. After Plagueis discovered Venamis' existence, the Muun doubted that the latter had been trained as a true [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith]], thus seeing the self-bestowed title of "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]]" as illegitimate and considered the secret apprentice, who was a Bith [[Gender/Legends|himself]], to be biologically related to their common [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], possibly as an [[Parent/Legends|offspring]].<ref name="DP" />

Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], Venamis posed as a [[Doctor/Legends|physician]], using fraudulent information regarding place of residence and practice, to free the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Naat Lare]] from the [[Bedlam Institution for the Criminally Demented]] on [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]] who had been incarcerated there three years before in [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]]. The Bith then tasked his potential apprentice to cull the population of [[marsh haunt]]s near a [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] settlement on [[Abraxin]].<ref name="DP" />

After Tenebrous died on [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] at the hands of Plagueis in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], the latter discovered that Venamis kept a list of certain Force-sensitive beings as potential apprentices of his own&mdash;other than Lare, they were a [[Shi'ido]] [[Unidentified Shi'ido|changeling]] who worked as a professional [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] and the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Unidentified Iktotchi prophet|prophet]] of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], as well as a being who had been executed, another being that had been previously killed in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] brawl, and one other being who had died of natural causes by that point. However, before Venamis could pursue his own agenda, he moved to fulfill Tenebrous' final command to eliminate Plagueis, leaving Lare on Abraxin.<ref name="DP" />

[[File:Plagueis_head.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Plagueis (pictured) bested Venamis and experimented on him to investigate midi-chlorians.]]
Traveling to [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]]&mdash;a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] owned by Plagueis and maintained as a personal retreat&mdash;Venamis [[Contest on Sojourn|engaged into a lightsaber duel with Plagueis]], and proved to have considerable skill with his [[Darth Venamis's lightsaber|lightsaber]], but he was eventually bested by Plagueis and forced to ingest a [[Coma-bloom/Legends|coma-bloom]], a poisonous species of flora, putting him into a coma. As part of his experiments with [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] over the following decades, Plagueis and his droid [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]] kept the comatose Venamis alive to manipulate and study. Around the year [[42 BBY/Legends|42 BBY]], Venamis was eventually allowed to die by Plagueis, his usefulness finally fulfilled. Afterward, he was [[Midi-chlorian manipulation|resurrected]] and killed again and again in the presence of 11-4D, as well as Plagueis's apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], until Venamis' organs finally ceased to function and Plagueis finally allowed the Bith to die for the final [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="DP" />

==Powers and abilities==
In his duel with Plagueis, Darth Venamis demonstrated a superior offensive skill in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] taught to him by his master, Darth Tenebrous. He also shared his master's enjoyment of fighting. Tenebrous had trained Venamis well, and he proved to be a capable fighter. Tenebrous made sure Venamis was an expert in Plagueis' style of lightsaber combat, Venamis even landing a strike at the side of Plagueis' neck. And so in their fight, Plagueis resorted to moving himself like a marionette, reacting to Venamis' moves. After Plagueis started this unorthodox course of action Venamis gradually realised the fight started to seem more like a training exercise than fight to the death. Unfortunately for Venamis this led him to become more sloppy and less precise, a cost that led to his defeat at Plagueis' hands.<ref name="DP" />

Venamis could also generate [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], as Plagueis sensed him about to do so, before he crossed his blades to Venamis's neck, and caused him to yield. Among his talents, was also the difficult ability to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Flight 2|levitate]] himself, doing so when Plagueis used the Force to break the [[Greel tree|greel]] branch he was perching on, and suspended himself in midair and continued the duel using that ability. Prior to the duel Venamis had also cloaked his connection to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], Plagueis commended him for hiding that connection, although Plagueis could still sense the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] within him. Despite his skill with a lightsaber and the Force, Venamis still failed to sense the death of his master, Darth Tenebrous, even mocking Plagueis when he thought he was lying.<ref name="DP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Venamis first appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]]. The novel tells the backstory of Darth Plagueis. It revealed that Venamis was [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous']] secret apprentice.
